name: Effective Range / Monotonic co-VC Dimension
details: The max-over-subfamilies consequence inherited the false unshifted comparison in relationship181. A one-concept class on a nonempty domain has effective range zero and monotonic coVC one. The corrected elementary bound is $\mathrm{coVC}^*\le\max\{1,\mathrm E\}$; no replacement graph edge is introduced.
proof: Let $\mathcal H=\{\{1\}\}$ on the one-point domain. Its only subfamilies are itself and the empty class, with coVC values one and zero respectively. Hence $\mathrm{coVC}^*(\mathcal H)=1$, while $\mathrm E(\mathcal H)=0$. The old derivation applied the refuted inequality $\mathrm{coVC}(\mathcal G)\le\mathrm E(\mathcal G)$ to each subfamily. Using instead $\mathrm{coVC}(\mathcal G)\le\max\{1,\mathrm E(\mathcal G)\}$ and effective-range subfamily monotonicity gives the corrected maximum bound.
witness_verification: At n=1, effective range is zero and monotonic coVC is one. This refutes the stated inequality by a strict finite endpoint gap; no unbounded-ratio or functional separation is claimed.
proof_source: Finite endpoint correction using parameter105 and the counterexample to relationship181. Original rejected derivation preserved at sync/covc_endpoint_corrections/originals/343_effective_range_monotonic_covc_dimension.json.
